name: particle_basic
description: Basic particle system with configurable speed, color, and count

particle_count.description: Number of particles in the simulation

particle_size.description: Radius of each particle in normalized screen coords

turbulence.description: Noise turbulence strength applied to particle velocity

noise_scale.description: Spatial frequency of the noise field

lifetime.description: Particle lifetime in seconds before respawn

trail_length.description: Number of trail segments per particle (1 = no trail)

background_alpha.description: Per-frame background fill alpha (lower = longer trails)

attractor_strength.description: Strength of central attractor (0 = none, negative = repel)

render1.description: Primary render output — call saveImage() on this operator

notes: Designed for td_tool.py render; all params map 1:1 to constant CHOP channels in the TD network.
